mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the monthly CPIAUCSL inflation index above 3% triggers a preemptive equity risk premium, pushing S&P 500 forward returns positive over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: CPIAUCSL crosses above 3.0 in the current month
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not statistically different from zero (t-test p > 0.05) during high-inflation regimes.

mechanism_narrative: Rising employment momentum as measured by PAYEMS exceeds 200,000 monthly increases, signaling labor market strength that supports S&P 500 positive 60-day forward returns.
failure_condition: Over 60-day horizon, returns are negative or flat despite sustained PAYEMS growth above 200k.

mechanism_narrative: A contraction in industrial production (INDPRO) below 100 triggers a supply-side risk premium, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive despite INDPRO remaining below 100 for the next 5 days.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in both HOUST (housing starts) and RSAFS (retail sales) above 1.5% and 5% of prior month, respectively, indicates resilient consumer and business demand, driving positive 20-day S&P 500 returns.
candidate_trigger: HOUST > 1.5 and RSAFS > 5 relative to prior month
failure_condition: 20-day returns are negative despite both proxies rising above thresholds.

mechanism_narrative: When FEDFUNDS remains above 5.0% for two consecutive months, the S&P 500 exhibits negative 60-day forward returns as investors anticipate higher borrowing costs.
failure_condition: 60-day returns are positive during the high-rate period.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in UNRATE below 3.5% for three months indicates weaker wage growth, which is associated with negative S&P 500 20-day forward returns.
failure_condition: 20-day returns are positive when UNRATE stays below 3.5 for three months.

mechanism_narrative: Consecutive quarters of industrial production (INDPRO) falling below 102.0 suggest supply-side bottlenecks, resulting in positive 60-day S&P 500 forward returns as investors price in recovery.
failure_condition: 60-day returns are flat or negative despite INDPRO remaining below 102 for two consecutive quarters.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in GDPC1 (real GDP) by over 2% in the current quarter followed by a rebound above 2% in the next quarter creates a momentum effect that drives positive 20-day S&P 500 returns.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 falls > -2% in current quarter and > +2% in next quarter
failure_condition: 20-day returns remain negative despite the GDP pattern.
